title: Polygraves
description: A grave mod that tries to be vanilla and widely compatible
body:
# Polygraves!
A simple grave mod that intends to be compatible with inventory manager mods, such as mods that keep certain items on death.

By design, it is pretty basic and doesn't have ALL the quality of life features you would normally expect.

## Features
Creates a grave block at your death location which stores all your dropped items.
- Can work in lava
- Supports modded items
- Can be mined with a silk touch pickaxe to get the block itself
- Take only, cannot be used as op storage (without any hoppers, that is)

## Compatibility
Tested to work with [Lenient Death](https://modrinth.com/mod/lenient-death) and I think [Keep Inventory Control](https://modrinth.com/mod/keep-inventory-control) works as well. Tested to work with Sodium (alongside Indium, however not sure if required). No guarantees that anything else works but based on how this mod is made it should hopefully work! _Modded inventory slots are untested and will most likely not work_

## Flaws
This mod, if the position you died at is not empty, will place the grave one block higher. This will forceably remove the block, which could be detrimental. _hint hint new bedrock breaking strategy_

## Notes
This is my first finished fabric mod, so it will probably have plenty of bugs.
USE AT OWN RISK

Also this mod does not have anything to do with Polymer.
